title: 1981-04-16_Pat_84.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes a theory of the 2-3-74 visionary experience as an encounter with a non-biological information-based life form that operates through the conjunction of two human minds (the Ditheon). Drawing on Platonic forms, medieval mysticism (Eckhart), evolutionary theology (Teilhard), and Spinoza, he argues that consciousness itself is pre-existent information that perceives the universe abstractly as the Logos—the pre-existent word and origin of substantial reality. His novel Valis becomes a vehicle for understanding how the universe is the body of Christ, with higher orders utilizing lower orders through backward-causation rather than linear evolution.
key_claims: Reality is fundamentally informational, not material; human brains are 'packets of very concentrated info' that the meta-entity deploys as building blocks.
Two human minds yoked temporally can create a higher-order consciousness (Ditheon) that perceives reality abstractly and outside causation, experiencing what Eckhart called 'stage 4' consciousness.
The 2-3-74 experience was PKD perceiving the universe as pre-existent Word/Logos—the abstract origin of reality itself—which is God's pure consciousness.
Evolution works backward from the future: the higher orders impose structure and compel existence of the lower preconditions they require, not the reverse.
Christ is the word-origin-basis of reality, and perceivers of this truth become 'Christ of Christ, word of word'—a self-aware reflection of the Logos.
Anamnesis (Platonic recollection) is the mechanism by which two disparate perceptions of the same world can be compared, abstracting to the pre-existent eternal forms.

tensions: PKD forgot when writing VALIS that the universe already derives from the Logos; he was seeing the origin, not an invasion—yet claims VALIS is 'somewhat true, more true than false.'
The claim that two human psyches 'do not equal' the info-organism seems to contradict the Ditheon theory; the adventitious second psyche must be 'added' as something external.
PKD oscillates between treating VALIS as an evolutionary phenomenon and as backward-causation from the future—he 'rethinks the whole theory of evolution.'
Anamnesis described both as 'recovery of the Forms' and as a mechanism requiring two disparate perceptions—unclear whether recollection is individual or comparative.
The relationship between Jesus as 'adventitious psyche' and all Ditheons being 'aggregated into one meta-organism' is left tentative ('it is entirely possible').
evidence_quotes: It is an info life form swimming in an info sea! + simply concentrates or combines info in a sort of super-concentration, located at what may be two loci, not one.

The greatest realization I've had is that my greatest experience (2-3-74) was in perceiving the word as the basis + origin of reality, from which reality perives; + that this word is the utterance of God + is 'anokhe' pure + absolute self-consciousness.

By knowing itself it changes itself irreversibly, toward perfection as a limit. The world is this evolving change-process—resembles Spinoza's 'Deus sive substantia sive natura' but is dynamic due to (1) self-knowledge + (2) the fact that it changes itself.

the bicameral mind -Fred, + Bob - in 'Scanner' can be seen as an evolutionary attempt at Ditheon that failed. It is of supreme significance that this info life form is not limited to human brains but exists outside them 'scrambled' into the sensible world.
Dianthropos is by necessity Ditheon! Anamnesis is merely a means to the higher goal of deification due to the higher faculties of the soul coming into use.
uncertainty_flags: The text is fragmented and difficult to parse at several points; OCR or transcription errors likely (e.g., 'molocules' for 'molecules', 'perives' for 'perives/derives', 'hysical' for 'physical').
The identity of 'Russ' is unclear; the 'postcards to Pat' reference is obscure—may refer to letters from another figure or the recipient's name.
The claim that PKD saw the info life form 'outside' him as 'objects + causal processes' is underdeveloped; how sensible/physical manifestation occurs is not explained.
'BTA' is mentioned as PKD's synthesis but its exact title is ambiguous—may refer to Valis trilogy or a specific section.
The reference to 'stage 4' of Eckhart's soul hierarchy is cited but not fully explained; PKD does not clarify what stages 1-3 entail.
The temporal relationship between the vision, the postcards, the Ditheon dream, and the writing of BTA is not clearly sequenced.
reading_excerpt: By knowing itself it changes itself irreversibly, toward perfection as a limit.
